human_review_text: The proposed work is concerned with time series generation and introduces an approach into encode the time series in the form of implicit neural representation through a TSNET,  a trend-seasonality-residual representation. The framework is applied to several regular and irregular time-series generation tasks with various percentages of missing data and compared with other approaches.
